name: Downtown Fort Walton Beach Holiday Market and Light Up the Night
address: 131 Brooks Street SE, Fort Walton Beach, FL 32548
paras: The City of Fort Walton Beach lists the Downtown Holiday Market and Light Up the Night Tree Lighting for Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 11 AM to 6 PM at the Fort Walton Beach Landing, 131 Brooks Street SE.

The city describes more than 100 local vendors, live music, food trucks, cookie decorating and a visit by Santa and Mrs. Claus. The Landing has new Christmas displays this year, including new lighting, a new tree and a Santa's Workshop, and the Fort Walton Beach Community Chorus carols before the tree lighting at 5:30 PM. The city page does not print a price.
tip: Stay for the 5:30 PM tree lighting, which starts promptly.

name: A Beachy Little Christmas at The Island
venue: The Island Resort and Convention Center
address: The Island Resort and Convention Center, Fort Walton Beach, FL
when_note: Noon to 4 PM on the beach
host: The Island Resort and Convention Center
paras: The Island Resort and Convention Center lists A Beachy Little Christmas on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from noon to 4 PM on the beach. The resort says the event is free and open to the public.
Families can meet Santa Claus and Misty the Mermaid for photos and build Christmas themed sandcastles. The resort page does not print a street address.
tip: Bring a small bucket and shovel for the Christmas sandcastles.

name: Emerald Coast Christmas Miracle Fiesta
address: 132 Jet Drive, Fort Walton Beach, FL 32548
when_note: Noon to 1 PM is for families of children with special needs; everyone welcome from 1 PM
paras: United for a Good Cause hosts a free Christmas Fiesta on Sunday, December 20, 2026, from noon to 6 PM at the Fort Walton Beach Recreation Center, 132 Jet Drive. The group says every child goes home with a gift.

The first hour, noon to 1 PM, is open only to families of children with special needs so they can enjoy it at a calmer pace, and everyone is welcome from 1 PM. The event includes entertainment, food for families, activity tables from partner agencies and giveaways of toys, bikes and presents. Families can register ahead, and walk-ins are welcome.
tip: Families with special needs can use the quieter noon to 1 PM hour.

name: Christmas Party with Santa at the Fort Walton Beach Library
address: Fort Walton Beach Library, Fort Walton Beach, FL
paras: The Okaloosa County Public Library Cooperative lists a Christmas Party with Santa at the Fort Walton Beach Library on Thursday, December 10, 2026, from 5 PM to 7 PM. It is a drop in event for all ages, and no registration is required.
Santa reads a story and children can take photos with him. The library also lists gingerbread house judging, crafts and hot cocoa. The listing does not print a price or a street address.
tip: Arrive early for the story, then stay for photos and cocoa.
